name: EPIC 201530733
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 7.8 solar radii and 0.97 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201530733 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.842415 (16th-84th percentiles 7.527049-8.180532), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201530733 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.966235 (16th-84th percentiles 0.870526-1.074816), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201530733: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4871.738 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201530733 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 5262.34375 (16th-84th percentiles 5089.179688-5441.953125), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.09 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 5,262 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.97 solar masses and 7.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,872 K at its surface.
